title: Paper Filing Charge on Late Quarterly Contribution and Wage Reports
content:
**Instruction note on paper reports.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, a paper filing charge is added to the late report penalty after the limit. It turns on two facts of the original report the penalty is worked out from: whether it was filed on paper, and the highest of the three monthly employee counts it shows.

1. A report filed on paper that shows at least 50 is charged the large paper filing charge of USD 200.00.
2. A report filed on paper that shows at least the electronic filing threshold of 10 but fewer than 50 is charged the mid-size paper filing charge of USD 100.00.
3. Any other report is charged no paper filing charge.

The electronic filing threshold is 10 employees in every financing class.

## Combinations

| Filed on paper | Highest monthly count | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 50 or more | USD 200.00 |
| Yes | 10 to 49 | USD 100.00 |
| Yes | 9 or fewer | None |
| No | Any | None |

**Hypothetical reports at the thresholds.** Paper reports whose highest counts are 50, 49, 10 and 9 are charged USD 200.00, USD 100.00, USD 100.00 and nothing respectively. A late report filed on paper and showing a highest count of 30 adds USD 100.00 after the limit; had the same report been filed through any channel other than paper, no paper filing charge would be added.
